info.title: cpool
info.description: Card pool generator for trading card game formats. Applies errata history and configurable criteria (e.g. word count) to export eligible card pools to Excel/CSV.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
CardPool — trading card game pool analysis and export tool.
Fetches ~12,000 cards from YGOProDeck, applies errata history from Yugipedia,
and exports cards eligible under configurable criteria such as word count.

commands.name: export
commands.description:
Export all card data to Excel (.xlsx) and CSV.
Examples:
  cpool export                                         # default: ≤25 words, no-materials, exclude pendulum link
  cpool export --words 20                              # ≤20 words
  cpool export --strip-materials false                  # include full material text in word count
  cpool export --exclude-types none                    # include all card types
  cpool export --exclude-types fusion synchro xyz link # main-deck cards only
  cpool export --exclude-types pendulum link flip      # also exclude Flip monsters
  cpool export --errata-mode latest                    # use current text only (fast — no Yugipedia fetch)
  cpool export --words -1                              # no word limit — export all cards
  cpool export --since 2025-01-01                      # also generate release notes for cards eligible since this date
  cpool export --words 30 --output ~/ygo               # ≤30 words, custom output dir

options.name: --words
options.description: Word-count threshold — cards with any printing at or below this limit are included (default: 25, use -1 for no limit) [default: 25]

options.name: --strip-materials
options.description: Strip fusion/synchro/xyz/link material requirements from effect text before counting; original materials are preserved in a separate column (default: true) [default: True]

options.name: --exclude-types
options.description: Exclude cards whose type contains any of these fragments (case-insensitive, repeatable). Use 'none' to include all types. Examples: pendulum, link, tuner, flip, ritual, fusion, synchro, xyz (default: pendulum link) [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --errata-mode
options.description: Which card text version to evaluate for eligibility: 'shortest' = any historical printing (default), 'latest' = current printing only (skips Yugipedia fetch) [default: shortest]

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory to write output files to (default: ./output) [default: output]

options.name: --since
options.description: Generate a release notes file alongside the export showing cards that became eligible on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

commands.name: inspect
commands.description:
Show all errata versions for a single card with word counts.
Examples:
  cpool inspect "Raiza the Storm Monarch"
  cpool inspect "Dark Magician"
